result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within the same priority. I compiled it (`mvn -q -o compile`) but did not run any tests, and I didn't add one. `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` isn't called from anything under `src/test`.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `DataStore.java`. I replaced the `ORDER BY` with the same priority `CASE` the sales rep's open-ticket query already uses, and updated the Javadoc to match. The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and tickets of other regions stay out.
